theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_cone_ratio_measurable
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ), SFinite μ → Measurable (fun p : Eucl N × (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N) => limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x p.1 < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (p.2 i) (x - p.1)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - p.1‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
